# cdnpro_isps (Data Source)

Lists ISP codes for `cdnpro_edge_hostname.client_zones[].isp`. Results are sorted by `code`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cdnpro_isps" "us" {
  region_code = "na.us"
}

# Name-to-code resolution stays an explicit HCL expression.
locals {
  att_isp_code = [for i in data.cdnpro_isps.us.isps : i.code if i.name == "ATT"][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region_code` (String) Only ISPs operating in this client region (a `cdnpro_client_regions` code).
- `search` (String) Substring match on code or name.

### Read-Only

- `isps` (Attributes List) Matching ISPs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--isps))

<a id="nestedatt--isps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `isps`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `name` (String)
